_about: Engineering inputs for the heat-sink example. SI units; every key carries its unit. These are the same values as the previously recorded run in results/heatsink_h25, so the new execution can be compared with it.

geometry._note: Aluminium base plate with straight full-depth fins; the outer fins are flush with the base ends.

devices._note: Two TO-247 packages on the base bottom, centred at x = L/2 -+ offset, y = W/2. Each loss enters as a uniform heat flux over its footprint.

cooling._note: Supplied film coefficient on every exposed face (25 W/m^2/K is typical of natural convection, 80 of moderate forced air); it is an input, not a CFD result. The uncovered bottom is adiabatic unless bottom_convective is true.

material._note: Aluminium from aipe_fieldsim.materials (k = 200 W/m/K); density and heat capacity do not affect a steady solve.

mesh._note: Maximum tetrahedron size per refinement level (minimum = half of it).
